question.ar: هل تبقى المنازعات ضد المؤسسات العمومية ذات الطابع الصناعي والتجاري أمام المحاكم العادية؟
question.en: Do disputes against public bodies of industrial and commercial character stay before the ordinary courts?

why.ar: المادة 800 لا تذكر إلا المؤسسات العمومية ذات الصبغة الإدارية، ولا نص في المخزن عن غيرها؛ والمادة 800 الفقرة الأولى تتكلم عن المنازعات الإدارية دون تعريفها.
why.en: Article 800 names only bodies of administrative character and no text in the store speaks of the others; its first paragraph speaks of administrative disputes without defining them.

protectiveReading.ar: الخانة تسأل عن الطابع الإداري، ويبقى الحكم للمحامي، مع ملاحظة الحد.
protectiveReading.en: The slot asks about administrative character; the lawyer decides, with the boundary note shown.

question.ar: ما دوائر الاختصاص الإقليمي للمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة، وما حكم دائرة لم تنصب محكمتها بعد؟
question.en: What are the areas of the specialised commercial courts, and what governs an area whose own court is not yet installed?

why.ar: المرسوم التنفيذي 23-53 (الجريدة الرسمية 2023 العدد 2، ص 18-19) والمرسوم التنفيذي 26-133 المعدل له (الجريدة الرسمية 2026 العدد 27، ص 10-11) يحددان خمسا وعشرين محكمة ودوائرها بالمجالس القضائية، ويمدان اختصاص المحاكم المنصبة إلى دوائر المحاكم الجديدة إلى حين تنصيبها؛ وهما غير موجودين في المخزن وطلبت إضافتهما.
why.en: Executive decree 23-53 (Official Journal 2023 no. 2, pp. 18-19) and executive decree 26-133 amending it (Official Journal 2026 no. 27, pp. 10-11) fix twenty-five courts and their areas by judicial council, and extend the jurisdiction of installed courts over the areas of new courts until those are installed; neither is in the store, and both have been requested.

reading.ar: يمتد اختصاص المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة المنصبة إلى دائرة المحكمة الجديدة إلى حين تنصيبها، فلا تعود المنازعة إلى القسم التجاري.
reading.en: The jurisdiction of the installed specialised commercial court extends over the new court's area until it is installed, so the dispute does not return to the commercial section.

reading.ar: لا تسري قواعد الاختصاص الجديدة في دائرة إلا من تاريخ تنصيب محكمتها.
reading.en: The new jurisdiction rules run in an area only from the installation of its own court.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه إلى المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة كلما اندرج النزاع في موادها، ودعوة المحامي إلى التحقق من المحكمة المختصة إقليميا.
protectiveReading.en: Warn about the specialised commercial court whenever the dispute is one of its matters, and ask the lawyer to check the court competent for the area.

question.ar: هل تخرج المنازعات العامة للضمان الاجتماعي مع هيئة الضمان الاجتماعي عن المحاكم الإدارية، وهل يشترط فيها طعن مسبق؟
question.en: Do general social security disputes with a social security body leave the administrative courts, and must a prior recourse come first?

why.ar: القانون 08-08 المتعلق بمنازعات الضمان الاجتماعي (الجريدة الرسمية 2008 العدد 11، ص 8-9) يرفع المنازعات العامة إجباريا أمام لجان الطعن المسبق (المادة 4)، ويجعل قرارات اللجنة الوطنية قابلة للطعن أمام المحكمة المختصة طبقا لقانون الإجراءات المدنية (المادة 15)، ولا يسند للجهات الإدارية إلا خلافات المؤسسات والإدارات العمومية بصفتها هيئات مستخدمة (المادة 16)؛ وهو غير موجود في المخزن وطلبت إضافته، ولم يبحث عن تعديلاته اللاحقة.
why.en: Law 08-08 on social security disputes (Official Journal 2008 no. 11, pp. 8-9) sends general disputes compulsorily to prior-recourse committees (art. 4), opens the national committee's decisions to challenge before the court competent under the Code of Civil Procedure (art. 15), and gives the administrative courts only disputes of public institutions and administrations acting as employers (art. 16); it is not in the store, has been requested, and later amendments were not searched.

reading.ar: المنازعة العامة للضمان الاجتماعي تبقى للمحكمة العادية بعد الطعن المسبق، إلا إذا كان المدعي مؤسسة أو إدارة عمومية بصفتها هيئة مستخدمة.
reading.en: A general social security dispute stays with the ordinary court after the prior recourse, unless the plaintiff is a public institution or administration acting as employer.

reading.ar: هيئة الضمان الاجتماعي طرف عمومي فيطبق معيار المادة 800.
reading.en: The social security body is a public party, so the test of article 800 applies.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه مع ذكر الاستثناء والطعن المسبق، ودعوة المحامي إلى التحقق، دون منع.
protectiveReading.en: Warn, naming the exception and the prior recourse, and ask the lawyer to check; never block.

question.ar: هل تخرج المنازعات الجمركية المدنية مع إدارة الجمارك عن المحاكم الإدارية؟
question.en: Do civil customs disputes with the customs administration leave the administrative courts?

why.ar: المادة 273 من قانون الجمارك في صيغة القانون المعدل له المنشور في الجريدة الرسمية 1998 العدد 61 (ص 52) تجعل الجهة القضائية المختصة بالبت في القضايا المدنية تنظر في الاعتراضات المتعلقة بدفع الحقوق والرسوم أو استردادها ومعارضات الإكراه وغيرها من القضايا الجمركية التي لا تدخل في اختصاص القضاء الجزائي؛ والقانون 17-04 لم يعدلها (المادة 115 منه)، ولم يبحث عن تعديلات أخرى؛ وهي غير موجودة في المخزن وطلبت إضافتها.
why.en: Customs Code art. 273, as worded by the amending law published in the Official Journal 1998 no. 61 (p. 52), gives the court that decides civil cases the objections on paying or refunding duties and taxes, objections to distraint and other customs cases outside the criminal courts; law 17-04 did not amend it (its art. 115), other amendments were not searched; it is not in the store and has been requested.

reading.ar: هذه المنازعات للمحاكم العادية رغم أن الإدارة طرف فيها.
reading.en: These disputes belong to the ordinary courts although the administration is a party.

reading.ar: يطبق معيار المادة 800 لأن الدولة طرف.
reading.en: The test of article 800 applies because the State is a party.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه مع ذكر الاستثناء ودعوة المحامي إلى التحقق، دون منع.
protectiveReading.en: Warn, naming the exception, and ask the lawyer to check; never block.

question.ar: هل يشترط في منازعات الضرائب شكوى مسبقة أمام الإدارة الجبائية وآجال خاصة قبل الدعوى أمام المحكمة الإدارية؟
question.en: Must a tax dispute go through a prior complaint to the tax administration, with special periods, before the action at the administrative court?

why.ar: قانون الإجراءات الجبائية غير موجود في المخزن، ولم يعثر على صيغته السارية في الجريدة الرسمية: أنشئ بقانون المالية لسنة 2002 وعدلته قوانين مالية لاحقة؛ ما يقال عن الشكوى المسبقة من الذاكرة فقط.
why.en: The Code of Tax Procedures is not in the store and its current wording was not found in the Official Journal: it was created by the finance law for 2002 and amended by later finance laws; what is said about the prior complaint comes from memory only.

reading.ar: من الذاكرة: الشكوى المسبقة شرط لقبول الدعوى الجبائية، والأجل يسري من قرار الإدارة.
reading.en: From memory: a prior complaint is a condition of admissibility of the tax action, and the period runs from the administration's decision.

reading.ar: تطبق قواعد المادتين 829 و830 دون شرط خاص.
reading.en: The rules of articles 829 and 830 apply without a special condition.

protectiveReading.ar: ملاحظة حدية تدعو المحامي إلى التحقق من النص الجبائي، دون منع.
protectiveReading.en: A boundary note asking the lawyer to check the tax text; never block.

checklist.item: Basis: the seller's obligation to deliver the thing sold in the state it was in at the time of sale (Civil Code, sale chapter, obligations of the seller, art. 364 as remembered) and what delivery consists of (putting the thing at the buyer's disposal so that he can take possession, art. 367 as remembered; delivery may also be by mere consent in some cases).

Check the place and time of delivery: where the contract is silent, delivery is due where the thing was at the time of sale (or the seller's domicile for things to be sent); a fixed delivery date must be shown from the contract, the invoice or the correspondence.
checklist.note: Article 394 ¶1 sets where and when the buyer takes delivery absent agreement or custom; article 368 ¶1 makes delivery of things to be sent complete on arrival. Civil Code article 282 (place of performance: a specific thing where it was when the obligation arose; other obligations at the debtor's domicile or establishment) is not in the store; the verifier read it in the Official Journal 1975 no. 78, p. 1006, and requested it: open point o10 (grade D).

checklist.item: Element: a valid sale concluded between the parties (date, thing sold, price); in commercial matters proof is free (Commercial Code art. 30: accepted invoice, correspondence, books); in civil matters writing may be required above a sum (Civil Code art. 333) and against a writing (art. 334).
checklist.note: Article 334 is in the store; not cited, as it concerns proof against an official deed or of a remainder. Electronic writing counts as writing (323 مكرر 1 ¶1). The proof regime of a mixed sale is open point o13.

checklist.item: Element: payment of the price or of part of it by the plaintiff (receipt, bank transfer); the buyer who has not paid may meet the seller's exception of non-performance (Civil Code art. 123 as remembered) and the seller's right to retain the thing until paid.

Element: the agreed delivery date has passed and the thing has not been delivered; the burden of proving delivery lies on the seller once the obligation is proven (proof of release from an obligation lies on the debtor, Civil Code art. 323 as remembered).

Prior step: formal notice (إعذار) to the seller before asking for specific performance (art. 164) and before damages (art. 179); its means (bailiff's act or registered letter, art. 180 as remembered) and the cases where it is not needed (art. 181: performance impossible or useless by the debtor's act, written refusal, etc.); check whether the contract makes the seller in default by the mere arrival of the term.
checklist.note: Imported from the formal-notice module; article 180 says warning, an act standing in its place, post as the code provides, or an agreement on default at the term.

checklist.item: Prior step: whether the absence of a formal notice makes the claim inadmissible or only affects damages and rescission; a protective reading warns rather than blocks unless a text states inadmissibility.
checklist.note: Articles 119, 164 and 179 state no inadmissibility; the module's steps warn.

checklist.item: Request: specific performance (delivery) under a penalty payment (غرامة تهديدية, Civil Code art. 174 and its final assessment under art. 175); the penalty is accessory and set by the judge.

Request: rescission of the sale for non-performance after notice (Civil Code art. 119), with the judge's power to grant the debtor a period, and the express resolutory clause (art. 120) and automatic dissolution where performance became impossible (art. 121).
Request: restitution of the price after rescission: the parties are restored to their prior state (Civil Code art. 122), and the amount paid must be stated.

Request: damages for the delay or for the non-performance (Civil Code art. 176, assessment art. 182), due only after formal notice (art. 179); no interest between individuals under the prohibition of interest (art. 454 as remembered); check any penalty clause (art. 183-184).
checklist.note: Article 454 ¶1 concerns loans between individuals, not this claim; no interest request is proposed.

checklist.item: Request: provisional execution and costs; costs fall on the losing party (Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure).

Limitation: the general fifteen-year limitation for contractual claims (Civil Code art. 308), counted from the date the obligation fell due (the agreed delivery date, art. 315 as remembered); counting by days, not hours (art. 314); the court does not raise limitation of its own motion (art. 321); interruption by a judicial claim or acknowledgement (art. 317-318).

Limitation that does NOT apply here: the one-year limitation for guarantee against hidden defects (art. 383) concerns defective delivered goods, not non-delivery; the shortened periods of art. 312 concern traders' claims for the price of supplies, not the buyer's claim for delivery.
checklist.note: Articles 383 ¶1 and 366 ¶1 run from delivery and become boundaries, with 383 ¶2 (no reliance on the year after fraudulent concealment); the periods module's one-year trader deadline is not imported, the plaintiff being the buyer.

checklist.item: Competent section: the civil section, or the commercial section of the ordinary court when the dispute is commercial (CCAP art. 531 et seq. as remembered); what happens when the court has no such section.

Territory: the court of the defendant's domicile as the general rule (CCAP art. 37), and the special options for contracts and supplies (CCAP art. 39: place where the contract was concluded or performed, or where the goods were to be delivered).
checklist.note: Whether the article 39 courts are options beside the domicile court is open point o12.

checklist.item: Exit: the specialised commercial courts (law amending the CCAP, 2022) for international trade, commercial companies, banks with merchants, maritime and air transport and insurance; a sale between merchants for international trade leaves the ordinary court; check the mandatory conciliation before the specialised commercial court.
Exit: an administrative court when a party is the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body (CCAP art. 800-801), for instance a public procurement contract.
Exit: the order-to-pay procedure (CCAP art. 306 et seq.) only for sums of money fixed, due and proven in writing; it may cover restitution of a price but not delivery or rescission.
checklist.note: The claim asks for delivery or rescission; the return of the price follows rescission (122 ¶1) and is not a sum due before judgment, so the order-to-pay exit (requests payment) is not imported.

checklist.item: Boundary: delivery of a thing different from or not conforming to the contract, or with hidden defects (guarantee, art. 379 et seq.), is not non-delivery.
Boundary: partial delivery or a shortfall in quantity (art. 365) has its own regime and a one-year limitation as remembered (art. 366).

Boundary: sale of real property: delivery of a building and the requirement of an official deed and publication at the land registry (Civil Code art. 324 bis 1 and land-registry rules); the claim then concerns real property.
Boundary: loss of the thing before delivery: the sale is dissolved and the price returned by law (Civil Code art. 369 as remembered); this is not a fault-based rescission.
Boundary: the seller's own claim for the unpaid price (the plaintiff is the seller) and the automatic rescission of a movable sale for unpaid price at term (art. 392 as remembered).
Boundary: consumer protection and commercial-practices laws (law 09-03, law 04-02) may give a consumer extra remedies; they do not replace the civil claim.
checklist.note: Searched the store's code list (civil-code, commercial-code, cpca, family-code, labour-disputes, labour-relations, law-22-13): neither law is in it. Requested as context. The e-commerce law 18-05 was read by the verifier in the Official Journal (2018 no. 28) and requested; open point o8.

checklist.item: Boundary: the criminal route (fraud, breach of trust) when the seller took the price with no intention to deliver; a pending prosecution on the same facts may suspend the civil claim.
checklist.note: The Penal Code (fraud, breach of trust) is not in the store; requested as context. The exit warns on a criminal case on the same facts.

checklist.item: Documents: the contract or the invoice, proof of payment of the price, the formal notice and its proof of service (bailiff's record or registered-letter receipt), correspondence showing the agreed delivery date.

Facts to state: date, object and price of the sale; payment and its date; the agreed delivery date; the notice and its date; non-delivery to date; the choice between performance and rescission (principal and alternative request).
Request kinds: delivery, rescission and restitution must each appear; damages is an accessory request resting on the damages articles.

Amendments: the Civil Code was amended in 2005 (law 05-10) on proof and on some contract rules; the CCAP 08-09 was amended in 2022 (law 22-13) to create the specialised commercial courts; check the version in force.
checklist.note: The store gives article 333 in its law-05-10 wording; the sale articles are in their ordinance-75-58 wording; law-22-13 is in the store and carried by the imported exit.

checklist.item: Store note on the sale articles and on articles 119, 122 and 123: the text is a snapshot at the 2026-10-26 discovery cut-off, with no lawyer verification. Was any of them amended after that date?
checklist.note: Kept as an open point; every own item of the record only warns.

checklist.item: Catalogue check: commercial-code 30 has a ledger that is not clean (notCovered). Is its wording the one in force?
checklist.note: The statement is used only as proof means; no item turns on it alone.

checklist.item: Commercial acts: which sales are commercial (Commercial Code opening articles), to choose the section and the proof rules.
checklist.note: Searched commercial-code.txt in the store for articles 1 to 4: only article 30 of the Commercial Code's opening book is there. Requested as context.

checklist.item: Neighbour of b6: civil-code 395 ¶1, the costs of taking delivery fall on the buyer unless custom or agreement provides otherwise.
checklist.note: Article 395 ¶1 allocates the costs of taking delivery; this claim is for the seller's failure to deliver, and no item of the record turns on who bears those costs.

checklist.item: Neighbour of b7: civil-code 387 ¶1, the price is paid at the place of delivery unless agreement or custom provides otherwise.
checklist.note: Article 387 ¶1 fixes where the buyer pays the price, not when it falls due or whether the seller may retain; the record's retention boundary n7 rests on 388 and 390, and no item turns on the place of payment of the price.

checklist.item: Neighbour of b17: civil-code 168 ¶2, the risks do not pass to the debtor despite the notice if he proves the thing would have perished at the creditor's as well, unless he accepted fortuitous events.
checklist.note: Article 168 ¶2 limits the passing of risks after notice; the record draws no rule from that passing (b17 only shows why the notice matters for element e5), and the loss of the thing is sent to boundary n3. The defence is the seller's to raise.

checklist.item: Neighbour of b19: civil-code 333 ¶2, the obligation is valued at the time of the legal act, and witness proof is allowed when the excess over the threshold comes only from accessories added to the principal.
checklist.note: Article 333 ¶2 measures the value at the time of the act and without accessories; the proof note of e1 already measures the sale itself (its price), so damages or other accessories claimed do not change it.

checklist.item: Neighbour of b25: civil-code 379 ¶2, the seller does not guarantee defects the buyer knew of at the sale or could have found by ordinary care, unless the seller assured him otherwise or concealed them by fraud.
checklist.note: Article 379 ¶2 limits the guarantee claim, which the record only names as a boundary (n1, n2) leaving this claim; it changes no rule of the non-delivery claim.

checklist.item: Electronic sale: Law 18-05 on e-commerce (supplier liable by operation of law, refund of a pre-order paid before stock, four-working-day return period from actual delivery, refund within fifteen days).
checklist.note: Not in the article store. Read by the verifier in the Official Journal 2018 no. 28, pp. 7-8 (arts. 15, 18, 22, 23) and requested; open point o8 (grade D until read twice).

checklist.item: New vehicle bought from an approved dealer: Executive Decree 22-383, specifications arts. 18-20 (advance cap, delivery periods, refund with an increase).
checklist.note: Not in the article store. Read by the verifier in the Official Journal 2022 no. 76, p. 11 and requested; later amendments not checked in the Official Journal; open point o9 (grade D until read twice).

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Article 179 says compensation is not due before notice and states no sanction on the claim; whether the petition or its service counts as an act that stands in the place of a warning (article 180), whether a notice served after filing suffices, and whether the lack of notice makes the request inadmissible or only unfounded, are readings. A reading never blocks: warn. The step counts as done only when the notice was served by a bailiff (means m1, and m2 whose warning a bailiff serves) and before the petition's day (owner's decision of 14 November 2026; article 180 «بانذاره», and «بعد اعذار» in articles 179, 119 and 164). A notice by post (m3, n11) or by another act (m4, n1), or one whose means or date before the petition is unknown (n1, n11, n12), leaves the step open: the rule language has no condition on 'done', so requiredWhen carries it. The step then asks for the unknown fact, or, when the means or the date is known and not of that kind, gives no finding of its own and leaves the warning to n1, n11 or n12.

message.en: Civil Code article 179: compensation is due only after the debtor is put on notice, unless a text provides otherwise or a case of article 181 applies. Check the notice, its means and its date (before the petition), or the exemption.

message.ar: المادة 119 من القانون المدني: في العقد الملزم للجانبين، يطلب الفسخ بعد إعذار المدين، وشرط الفسخ الاتفاقي لا يعفي من الإعذار (المادة 120)، وبيع المنقولات الذي لم يدفع ثمنه عند الأجل يفسخ دون سابق إنذار (المادة 392). تحقق من الإعذار ووسيلته وتاريخه وأنه سابق على العريضة، أو من حالة الإعفاء.
message.en: Civil Code article 119: in a bilateral contract, rescission is claimed after putting the debtor on notice; an agreed rescission clause does not dispense with it (article 120), and a sale of movables unpaid at the term is rescinded without prior warning (article 392). Check the notice, its means and its date (before the petition), or the exemption.

label.ar: الإعذار عن طريق البريد على الوجه المبين في القانون (لم يعثر على النص الذي يبين هذا الوجه؛ النقطة المفتوحة o2)
label.en: Notice by post in the way the code provides (the text that sets out that way was not found; open point o2)
An act that stands in the place of a warning

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Article 119 puts the claim for performance of a bilateral contract after notice, and article 164 compels performance in kind after notice under articles 180 and 181; neither says whether a claim for a sum of money, for delivery, for the return of a thing or for the return of leased premises (eviction) is such a claim, nor what follows from the lack of notice (open point o6). Warn, never block. The step counts as done only when the notice was served by a bailiff (means m1, and m2 whose warning a bailiff serves) and before the petition's day (owner's decision of 14 November 2026; article 180 «بانذاره», and «بعد اعذار» in articles 179, 119 and 164). A notice by post (m3, n11) or by another act (m4, n1), or one whose means or date before the petition is unknown (n1, n11, n12), leaves the step open: the rule language has no condition on 'done', so requiredWhen carries it. The step then asks for the unknown fact, or, when the means or the date is known and not of that kind, gives no finding of its own and leaves the warning to n1, n11 or n12.

message.ar: المادتان 119 و164 من القانون المدني: يطالب بتنفيذ العقد ويجبر المدين على التنفيذ العيني بعد إعذاره طبقا للمادتين 180 و181. تحقق من الإعذار ووسيلته وتاريخه وأنه سابق على العريضة، أو من حالة الإعفاء.
message.en: Civil Code articles 119 and 164: performance is claimed, and the debtor compelled to perform in kind, after notice under articles 180 and 181. Check the notice, its means and its date (before the petition), or the exemption.

description.ar: اليوم الذي يصبح فيه الدين مستحق الأداء.
description.en: The day the debt becomes due.

message.ar: المادة 308 من القانون المدني: يتقادم الالتزام بخمس عشرة (15) سنة من يوم استحقاقه (المادة 315) فيما عدا ما ورد فيه نص خاص، وتحسب المدة وفق المادة 314، ولا تقضي به المحكمة تلقائيا (المادة 321). وتسري هذه المدة أيضا على الريع المستحق على الحائز سيء النية أو على متصرف المال المشاع (المادة 309)، وعلى الحق الذي حرر به سند (المادة 313، محل قراءتين). تحقق من تاريخ الاستحقاق ومن كل انقطاع أو وقف، ومنه عدم أهلية الدائن أو غيابه أو الحكم عليه بعقوبة جنائية ولو كان له نائب قانوني (المواد 316 و317 و318)، ومن وجود نص خاص بمدة أقصر، كدعاوى عقد التأمين والأوراق التجارية والضمان الاجتماعي (نقاط مفتوحة). وطريقة حساب السنوات، وامتداد المدة إذا انتهت في يوم عطلة، وأثر الإعذار أو الرسالة في قطعها، وكفاية تاريخ العقد عن تاريخ الاستحقاق، محل قراءات محفوظة (نقاط مفتوحة).
message.en: Civil Code, article 308: an obligation is time-barred after 15 years from the day it falls due (article 315), save where a special text applies; counted under article 314; the court does not apply it of its own motion (article 321). The same period governs revenue owed by a possessor in bad faith or by the manager of jointly owned property (article 309), and a right for which a written instrument was drawn up (article 313, two readings kept). Check the due date, any interruption or suspension, including the creditor's incapacity, absence or criminal sentence even where he has a legal representative (articles 316, 317, 318), and whether a special text sets a shorter period, such as actions on an insurance contract, on bills and cheques, or social-security disputes (open points). How the years are counted, whether the period runs on when it ends on a holiday, whether a formal notice or a letter interrupts it, and whether the contract date can stand in for the due date are kept with their readings (open points).

deadlines.interpretiveNote: Four readings rest under this deadline, kept open on the owner's instruction (verifier, follow-up 1, boundary cases bc5, bc9, bc10, bc11, bc12, bc16). How a year is counted: by the Gregorian calendar (civil-code 3 ¶1) or as a fixed number of days (314 ¶1 'بالايام لا بالساعات'), open point o15. Whether a period ending on a non-working day runs to the next working day (cpca 405 ¶4) or ends on that day (405 ¶1 speaks of the periods 'في هذا القانون'), open point o16. Whether a formal notice by bailiff or a registered letter is an interrupting 'تنبيه' (317 ¶1), open point o8. Whether a contract made less than the period ago shows the claim in time without its due date (315 ¶1), open point o17. The rule follows the protective reading of each: calendar counting with a band widened by the leap days fifteen years can hold, so a fixed count of days also warns; no extension; no interruption by a notice or letter; the due date is asked. Either way an expired period only warns.

reading.ar: تحسب السنوات بالتقويم الميلادي، وتكمل المدة بانقضاء آخر يوم منها ولو كان يوم عطلة، ولا يقطعها الإعذار ولا الرسالة، وتبدأ من تاريخ الاستحقاق الذي يسأل عنه المحامي.
reading.en: Years are counted by the calendar, the period is complete at the end of its last day even if a holiday, a formal notice or a letter does not interrupt it, and it starts on the due date, which the lawyer is asked for.

reading.ar: تحسب السنة بعدد ثابت من الأيام، وتمدد المدة إلى أول يوم عمل إذا انتهت في يوم عطلة، ويقطعها الإعذار بواسطة المحضر أو الرسالة، وتعد الدعوى في أجلها متى كان العقد المنشئ للالتزام أحدث من المدة.
reading.en: A year is a fixed number of days, a period ending on a holiday runs to the next working day, a formal notice by bailiff or a letter interrupts it, and the claim is in time whenever the contract that created the obligation is more recent than the period.
